description: This file implements the ValueSplittingHeaderList class, which provides iteration over header list entries, splitting header values based on cookie separators and other delimiters, used within the QUIC protocol implementation.

classes.name: ValueSplittingHeaderList
classes.description: A class that provides iteration over header list entries, splitting header values based on delimiters.

classes.name: ValueSplittingHeaderList::const_iterator
classes.description: An iterator class for traversing the split header values within the header list.

methods.name: ValueSplittingHeaderList::begin
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the beginning of the split header list.

methods.name: ValueSplittingHeaderList::end
methods.description: Returns an iterator to the end of the header list.

methods.name: ValueSplittingHeaderList::const_iterator::operator++
methods.description: Advances the iterator to the next header fragment.

methods.name: ValueSplittingHeaderList::const_iterator::operator*
methods.description: Dereferences the iterator to access the current header key-value pair.

methods.name: ValueSplittingHeaderList::const_iterator::operator->
methods.description: Provides pointer access to the current header key-value pair.

methods.name: ValueSplittingHeaderList::const_iterator::UpdateHeaderField
methods.description: Updates the current header field by parsing the header value and splitting based on delimiters.

methods.name: ValueSplittingHeaderList::ValueSplittingHeaderList
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the header list for iteration.
